summary: Modularize and harden repair lifecycle checker

delivery.outcome: Modularize src/repair_check.py under 500 lines and harden semantic validation against bool-as-int acceptance, non-int budget ValueError crashes, unhashable scope path TypeError crashes, empty/control/backslash paths, duplicate JSON keys, symlink escapes, and JSON Schema pattern/enum drift.
nonGoals: No breaking changes to existing valid or invalid repair lifecycle fixtures or schemas.

architecture.decision: Split repair_check.py into repair_primitives.py, repair_validators.py, and CLI/loader repair_check.py while preserving every public symbol and finding code.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-010 commit on main.

validation.evidence: Unit tests, repair_check self-test, modularity budget, and governance check pass.
